acceptedAnswer.text: A thigh lift is a surgical procedure that removes excess skin and fat from the thighs to improve firmness and contour.

mainEntity.name: Is a thigh lift the same as thigh liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Liposuction removes fat only, while a thigh lift removes loose skin and reshapes the thighs.
When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a regulated facility, it is considered a safe and established procedure.

mainEntity.name: How long does recovery take after a thigh lift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients resume daily activities within 2–4 weeks, with full recovery over several months.
Yes, but scars are placed strategically and fade over time with proper care.
Results are long-lasting if body weight remains stable.

mainEntity.name: Can a thigh lift be combined with other procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is often combined with tummy tuck or body lift surgery after weight loss.

mainEntity.name: Does exercise help after a thigh lift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exercise improves muscle tone but cannot replace surgical skin removal.

mainEntity.name: Who should consider a thigh lift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patients with loose thigh skin after weight loss or ageing and stable weight.
Overall health and skin condition are more important than age alone.
